title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-samira
content:
Console / Observability triage scratchpad - Samira

2026-03-03 quick notes (daily run)

Top priority items:
- [P1] customer ACME Corp: dashboard 500s on historical traces page (OBS-5123). Reported 2026-03-02 16:12 PDT.
  - Example error: GET /console/traces?service=payment returns 502 -> upstream timeout from trace-collector v2.1.
  - Repro steps: open dashboard -> click service filter -> select time range > 6h -> page hangs then 502. Seen in us-west only.
  - Temporary workaround: reload with time range <= 2h.
  - Assigned to Alex. Need to check trace-collector logs + scaling.

- [P2] dashboard time-series widget missing series for some customers after rollout 2026-02-28 (possible feature flag fallout).
  - Symptoms: empty series but other customers fine. Likely related to feature-flag new-aggregation-optimizations.
  - Quick check: toggle flag for affected org in staging -> confirms behavior.
  - Action: revert flag for orgs with active dashboards until fix. Jordan to coordinate with feature flagging team.

Notes / breadcrumbs:
- Logs to inspect: trace-collector (collector-01..03), ingest-proxy, metrics-aggregator.
- Useful queries:
  - k8s logs: kubectl -n observability logs collector-01 -c collector --since=2h | grep "timeout"
  - ES search: GET /_search {
      "query": {"term": {"request.path": "/console/traces"}}
    } (run limited time range)
- Dashboards to reference: "Traces Overview", "Collector Latency", "Widget Render Errors" (console-dashboard id: dash-102)

Customer follow-ups to schedule:
- ACME: ask for exact repro (org id, user id, query example). Offer to schedule 30m screen share.
- Beta customer: lost series — need sample dataset + affected org id. Jordan to DM.

Open hypotheses:
1) Collector autoscaler hiccup in us-west -> insufficient pods during high cardinality queries -> upstream timeouts. Check HPA events around 2026-03-02 15:45-16:30.
2) Aggregation opt flag introduces rare null-series bug for orgs with >1000 series. Happens when aggregator flushes during compaction.
3) Network flapping between frontend and collector in us-west AZ-a. (low prob but keep on radar)

Quick TODOs (today):
- [ ] Pull collector logs for 2026-03-02 15:30-17:00 (Samira)
- [ ] Check HPA events and pod restart counts (Samira)
- [ ] Ask ACME for sample query + org id (Samira)
- [ ] Toggle feature-flag for affected orgs in staging and prod (Jordan)
- [ ] Start a canary revert for new-aggregation-optimizations if flag toggle reproduces fix (Product + Release)
- [ ] Add alert rule: repeated 5xxs on /console/traces -> pager after 3m (SRE review)

Meeting notes from 2026-03-03 standup:
- Alex: saw elevated 99th latency on collector starting 15:40. Restarted collector-02 as test -> latency dropped temporarily.
- Jordan: feature-flag rollback in staging fixed missing series. Planning to coordinate prod rollback window 18:00-19:00 PST.
- Samira: collecting logs + prepping SLAs email for ACME support.

Things to remember / non-blocking:
- There was a related rolling restart (release-engineering) around 2026-02-28 that touched aggregator config - double-check changeset (PR #789).
- Add to postmortem checklist: ensure feature-flag gating covers orgs with >500 series.
- Consider adding a synthetic test hitting traces page with large time range hourly for us-west region.

Quick commands & snippets for follow-up:
- kubectl -n observability get hpa collector -o yaml | egrep -A2 "events"
- kubectl -n observability describe deploy collector | egrep -A5 "Events"
- ES example quick: curl -s -u readonly:*** "https://es.prod.internal/console_traces/_search?q=request.path:%5C"/console/traces%5C"&size=0&timeout=30s" | jq .timed_out

Unresolved questions:
- Is the collector autoscaler observing the right custom metric (ingest-rate vs. CPU)? (ask infra team)
- Were there any network policy changes to us-west AZs in last 7 days? (ask networking)

Follow-up plan (short):
- EOD 2026-03-03: have concrete list of log snippets + HPA events and proposed immediate mitigation (rollback or scale-up).
- If rollback chosen, coordinate with release-engineering and product for the 18:00 window. Send customer-facing note draft to CS.

Customer-facing note draft (for CS):
- Subject: Update on Traces dashboard 500s
- Body: Hi <Customer>, we are actively investigating intermittent 500/502 errors on the Traces dashboard in us-west. Preliminary analysis shows it is related to recent aggregation changes and autoscaler behavior. We have a mitigations plan (rollback + increased collector replicas) and will share next steps by 19:00 PST. Apologies for the disruption.

End of scratchpad

----
Meta: quick personal TODOs
- move any confirmed steps into JIRA ticket OBS-5123 (Samira)
- pair with Alex for log hunting 10:00 PST 2026-03-04
- clean up and add to Confluence postmortem template after incident closure
